method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of the completeness proof plan in both FOL and propositional branches, direct checking of every membership, satisfaction, consistency, quantified-instance and term-model condition, and exact formula, macro, token, tag, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Outline of the completeness proof: perspective shift, atomic model construction, complete consistent extensions, Henkin saturation, term models, identity quotienting and the truth lemma.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The proof becomes tractable after replacing the goal entailment-implies-derivability with the equivalent claim that every consistent Gamma is satisfiable, suggesting construction of the structure or valuation described by Gamma.
samples.checks: Both completeness formulations, their directions, the FOL/propositional alternatives and every Gamma/A formula are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For atomic information, interpret constants and predicates directly, or assign true exactly to Gamma's propositional variables. Consistency prevents both B and not-B. Extend Gamma while preserving consistency and deciding every atomic sentence; the resulting complete set then supports an induction proving satisfaction of complex formulas.
samples.checks: The natural-number domain, constant indices, predicate tuples, valuation biconditional, negated satisfaction formulas, conjunction/disjunction membership clauses and Gamma-subset-Gamma-star relation are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: First-order existential formulas may lack witness constants, so add infinitely many constants with linking sentences. Using all terms as the domain gives canonical function interpretations. Identity then requires replacing individual terms by sets of terms forced equal by Gamma, so arithmetically equal expressions receive one value.
samples.checks: The witness obstruction, no-constant-language example, consistency qualification, term-function construction, fixed identity interpretation, arithmetic examples and quotient-domain motivation retain their scope and order.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The formal proof studies complete consistent sets, creates a saturated extension, applies Lindenbaum's lemma to obtain Gamma-star, defines its term model or valuation, proves the truth lemma A is satisfied iff A belongs to Gamma-star, and finally adapts the term model for identity.
samples.checks: Every guarded existential/universal clause, closed-term quantifier, Gamma/Gamma-prime/Gamma-star role, term-model and valuation branch, truth-lemma biconditional and six references are exact.

source_observations: The frozen source's singular phrase all sentence in Gamma is rendered as grammatical Marathi plural without changing the quantified scope.
The outline states that conditions (a) and (b) suffice before later results derive the connective closure summarized as (c); the translation preserves that proof plan.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, tags, labels, identifiers and reference options match exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
संतृप्त वाक्यसंच is a provisional specialist adaptation recorded in T190; the official witnesses attest the saturation family but not this exact model-theory phrase.
पद-प्रतिमान and संपूर्ण वाक्यसंच are definition-controlled compounds recorded in T191 and T192 and remain open to specialist review.
